_why: Patch-note lines that announce a whole feature in one sentence without numbers ('Full shop rework, including many new items'). The matcher cannot tie such a line to fields by words, so every change it announced kept the eye: the headline 'not in patch notes' of City Never Sleeps, Old Gods and the 2025-05-08 shop rework counted features Valve had announced (hidden-story review 2026-10-05). Each entry ties ONE line of ONE patch to the changes it announces, scoped by field and by kind of operation, never by a whole file: the numbers of a new or reworked entity that the notes do not give stay hidden — they are what the site is for. pipeline/match.py:blanket_lines applies them; a change it covers is 'described' and linked to the line.
_format: patch: the patch id. line: a piece of the line's text (case-insensitive). why: the reason. match: a list of scopes; a change is covered when it fits one scope: file, path (regex on the field path, '@add' / '@remove' / '@return' for an entity's event), ops (add / remove / change / return), kinds (catalog kind), id (regex on the entity id).

lines.line: All hero stats rebalanced alongside the shop rework
lines.why: Every hero's base stats and per-boon growth were retuned with the shop rework (Abrams Max Health 570 -> 720); the line names them all and gives no numbers.
Guardians, Walkers, Shrines and the Patron got new health values 'as part of damage value changes in the shop'; only their health fields, nothing else of the buildings.

lines.line: Full shop rework, including many new items
lines.why: The items added to and removed from the shop. Only the events: the numbers of the existing items are not in the notes and stay hidden (audit verdicts TRUE_HIDDEN: Extra Health 160 -> 175 and 48 others).

lines.line: an Enhanced or Legendary item might make an appearance
lines.why: Old Gods, New Blood gave the shop items an Enhanced version (the upgrade entry m_vecAbilityUpgrades[0]); bonuses that appear with it are what the line announces. Later tweaks of Enhanced bonuses (2026-03-21: 77 rows) are not covered.

lines.line: Behold the Patrons: NEW BOSSES, BASES, TROOPERS
lines.why: The new bosses, bases and troopers came and the old ones went: their add / remove events only. Their numbers (Patron Health 5625 -> 12000, Max Health Generator 7000 -> 9000) are not in the notes and keep the eye.

lines.line: you can exchange your high tier items for a Corrupted version
lines.why: City Never Sleeps: the Broker trades an item for its Corrupted version (m_CorruptedItemInfo: bonuses plus random penalties). A version that appears whole is what the line announces; the corrupted shop, its price per tier and its penalty table come with it.

lines.line: Street Brawl grants you a corrupted item after the item draft in Round 5
lines.why: The round is the new Street Brawl field m_iCorruptItemRound = 5 (a field that appears has no old value, so the line's lone number never paired with it).
The golden statues' rewards were rebuilt: new permanent buffs (spirit resist, bullet resist, ability range, move speed) and the statue's reward pools moved into the new powerup loot table.
